# statusdrift_on_call_schedules (Data Source)

Fetches all on-call schedules.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "statusdrift_on_call_schedules" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder ID for Terraform state.
- `on_call_schedules` (Attributes List) List of on-call schedules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--on_call_schedules))

<a id="nestedatt--on_call_schedules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `on_call_schedules`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the schedule is active.
- `frequency` (String) Rotation frequency.
- `id` (Number) The ID of the on-call schedule.
- `monitor_group_id` (Number) The monitor group ID this schedule is scoped to, if any.
- `name` (String) The name of the on-call schedule.
- `scope_type` (String) Schedule scope: org_default or monitor_group.
- `timezone` (String) IANA timezone.
